title: Arte Caprichoso de Recorte de Papel Hecho a Mano: Perro Golden Retriever 3D de Pie
prompt: A whimsical handmade paper artwork on a wooden desk: a hand-drawn cartoon golden retriever dog cut from the paper and folded into a small standing 3D figure. The dog is sticking out its tongue and wagging its tail, looking happy and excited. Next to it is the empty silhouette cutout space where the dog was removed from the paper sheet. Warm natural lighting, craft aesthetic, charming handmade feel.
